title: Mail at scale: receiving, storage, and a message list that holds 200,000 rows
summary: Implementation plan for IMAP receiving, tiered message storage, virtual-mode message list, column control, threading, and read-key behaviour, with a 2026-08-29 per-section build status.
notes: Design/plan document with strong SPEC signals (library trade-off table, storage tiers and indices, IMAP command sequences, keybinding and column tables) plus decision-style rationale but no ADR frontmatter, no Status/Decision/Consequences structure, and multiple decisions rather than one, so not ADR. Updated 2026-08-29 with a per-section status: all six Sequence steps marked built, and two parts explicitly never built (three-tier storage; the Exchange path, since Microsoft work shipped via Graph). Doc also notes the earcon/braille status table is left as originally written though both are now built. Nothing has run against a real mail account.
